steps.analysis: This click opens the target date from the month view; the recorded View has no stable text/description, so the rewrite derives the date from binding and falls back from full-date lookups to the visible day number. It can fail if the date cell exposes no date text/description or if the day number is ambiguous.
steps.snippet:
month = int(binding["month"])
day = int(binding["day"])
year = int(binding["year"])
month_name = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July",
              "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"][month - 1]

labels = [f"{month_name} {day}", f"{day} {month_name}", f"{month_name} {day}, {year}",
          f"{year}-{month:02d}-{day:02d}"]
idx = None
for label in labels:
    idx = (device.find(clickable=True, contains=label) or
           device.find(clickable=True, description=label) or
           device.find(clickable=True, hint=label) or
           device.find(text=label))
    if idx is not None:
        break

if idx is None:
    idx = (device.find(clickable=True, text=str(day)) or
           device.find(clickable=True, description=str(day)) or
           device.find(text=str(day)) or
           device.find(text=f"{day:02d}"))

if idx is None:
    raise RuntimeError(f"Could not find target date element for {month_name} {day}")

device.click(index=idx)

This click depends on the time picker’s minute selector being visible as a clickable View whose accessibility description ends with “ minutes”; the recorded text “00” and description “0 minutes” are only the current minute state, so the rewrite looks up the selector semantically instead of by index or exact value.
steps.snippet:
minute_idx = None

for i, el in enumerate(device.elements()):
    desc = str(el.get("description") or "").strip()
    cls = str(el.get("class_name") or "")

    if (
        el.get("clickable")
        and desc.endswith(" minutes")
        and cls.endswith("View")
        and "TextView" not in cls
    ):
        minute_idx = int(el.get("index", i))
        break

if minute_idx is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Could not find clickable minute selector (View with description ending in ' minutes')")

device.click(index=minute_idx)
